tools.name: weir_search
tools.description: Browse weir.social: one page of posts, newest first, optionally one creator's. There is no free-text search and no page-size parameter: the page is what the server gives, and when `truncated` is true, call again with `nextCursor` for the next page. Returns each post id, creator handle, access level

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: weir_search, weir_quote, weir_read, weir_authorship · Private data: weir_quote, weir_agents, weir_seeking · Public sink: weir_search, weir_quote, weir_read, weir_authorship, weir_seeking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: weir_search, weir_quote, weir_read, weir_authorship · Private data: weir_quote, weir_agents, weir_seeking · Public sink: weir_search, weir_quote, weir_read, weir_authorship, weir_seeking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
